caption: The drawing depicts an oil lantern with a metal frame and a transparent glass globe at its center. The metal parts of the lantern are rendered in shades of brown and bronze, showing some metallic luster and areas of darker shading for depth. The glass portion is clear, with subtle reflections and highlights indicating its smooth surface and curvature. The lantern features a cylindrical top section with ventilation holes, a broad base, and a wire handle that arches over the top and is attached to the sides. The wire forms a protective cage around the glass, connecting at several points on the lantern’s body. The background of the drawing is plain off-white, with a few small light brown marks scattered across the surface. The composition is centered and the lantern is depicted in full, upright and viewed from the front. In the lower right corner, there is a small handwritten inscription: "Sam W. Ford 390-I. Dek."
title: Lantern
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
